description: This file defines the RetrievePolicyResponse class, which represents the response to a retrieve policy command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from various inputs, serializing to JSON, and accessing the policy data.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a retrieve policy command, including methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and access to the policy data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a response with typed PolicyId, Policy, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a RetrievePolicyResponse instance.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the Policy object contained in this response.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the policy as a JsonValue, considering the schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the policy entity in the response, returning a new instance.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers in the response, returning a new instance.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource; in this case, the root.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the policy data to a JsonObjectBuilder for serialization.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is of the same type for equality comparison.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on policy ID, policy, and superclass equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on superclass, policy ID, and policy.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
